items.title: Vampire Walking with a Parasol
items.alt: A vampire in a fitted navy coat strolls beneath one plum parasol held above a clearly visible smiling face.
items.description: A vampire in a fitted navy coat strolls beneath one plum parasol held above a clearly visible smiling face. Useful for weather vocabulary.

items.title: Vampire with a Flower Basket
items.alt: A vampire grandmother in a plum cape holds a shallow basket of three large autumn flowers at waist height.
items.description: A vampire grandmother in a plum cape holds a shallow basket of three large autumn flowers at waist height. Useful for family story cards.
